tips.text: Join a clan that already has the Zephyr research done instead of building your own Tenno Lab.
Join a clan that lets new members replicate right away; some require a minimum rank.
Expect at least six days of back-to-back research in your own lab; each part unlocks only after the Zephyr research.
Farm the 600 Oxium before you reach the Foundry; each part needs 200.
Start all three parts together; each costs 15,000 cr and takes 12 hours.
Keep base Zephyr even with Zephyr Prime; subsuming Airburst needs the base frame.
Players rate Zephyr one of the easier frames; the Oxium is the only real cost.
